Name: Stardew Valley Summer Swimsuits - CP
Author: chefrude
Description:
[b][u][size=5][color=#00ff00]Description
[/color][/size][/u][/b][size=3]This mod is a [/size][b]CONTENT PATCHER[/b][size=3] mod, which requires [b]SMAPI[/b] to work. See [color=#ff00ff][b]INSTALL[/b][/color] instructions below.[/size]

[size=3]﻿New swimsuits for most townies [/size][size=2](Dwarf, Krobus, Gunther, Morris, Willy, Qi, the Wizard, Governor, and Sandy don't apply for example)[/size][size=3].  The main mod includes Vanilla compatible SPRITES as well as PORTRAITS.

Alternate versions: Diverse SDV.

The mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4079/]SDVO (Seasonal Diverse Villager Outfits)[/url] is gonna drop 2.0 in the next month or so.
It will include even more diversity INCLUDING my swimsuits (ONLY at the beach)! Keep on the look out for that.[/size]

[size=3]You can choose to have them in swimsuits:[/size]
[list]
[*]All Summer long
[*]All year long (except winter) [b][code]﻿[/code][b][color=#00ff00][size=4]NEW[/size][/color][/b][/b]
[/list] ﻿or[list]
[*]Only during the 11th of Summer, which includes the Luau event (and the rest of that day)
[/list]
﻿[b][u][color=#ff00ff][size=4]Install[/size][/color][/u][/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Mod Compatibility
[/size][/u][/b]This mod is now compatible with [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/]Diverse SDV[/url]!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZR86RSn.png[/img]
Choose the Diverse version of the mod in the file tab, to use it.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y2OfVQf.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/JZd2bAx.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/DDzdQRh.gif[/img]
George in his wheelchair has floaties now!


[u][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Mod Options via Config.json
[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=2]All versions of this mod include a readme that details how to configure variable options, for that version. Please read that file to learn what you can change, and how to change it. 

[/size]It may be possible to mix and match SDV Swimsuit versions. All assets (pngs) with identical filenames can be hot swapped without problems. Anything with a "_<word>" ending means there is an alternate version in that pack, and may require some advanced editing (filename or content.json) to be able to use them.

[u][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Known Issues[/color][/size][/b][/u][list]
[*]Marnie does not change into swimsuit, during the Luau, until after the player starts the Luau event. She's stirring the soup, so thats probably more hygienic anyway.
[*]Currently, the floatie option for George only applies to his portrait, not his spritesheet. Floaties were implemented in the spritesheets for "swimming" animations. Will be adding floaties to George while he is in the wheelchair, soon.
[*]Longevity + CP can fight, and Longevity tends to win. Typical modded sprites, such as marriable NPCs, will get longevity spritesheets and not CP spritesheets. If you notice that some NPCs wear swimsuits (like Lewis and Gus) that may be the problem.
[*]Any special animations that occur during the summer (umbrellas, skating, etc) will not be in swimsuits (as these were never made).[color=#ffff00]**[/color]
[/list]
[center][b][u][color=#ff7700][size=4][/size][/color][/u][/b][/center][b][u][color=#ff7700][size=4]Footnotes
[/size][/color][/u][/b][size=3][color=#00ff00]*[/color]If you use a different portrait/sprite set (non-Vanilla) and would like to make these swimsuits compatible with those portraits/sprites, let me know, if I have time Ill consider expanding compatibility. [/size][size=2]I can be reached via the comments here, but would [b]prefer[/b] if you contact me via [b]SDV Discord[/b], in the [b]#modding[/b] channel. @chefrude.[/size]

[color=#ffff00]**[/color][size=3]These sprites and portraits were originally made for the Total Bathhouse Overhaul (TBO) mod, which only required "Walking and Standing" animation sets. So all other extra sprites were removed. If there is an overwhelming demand for these sprites to be swimsuited, I will consider adding those to the spritesheets as well. [/size]
[size=2]
Thanks to the SDV Discord community for testing and helping me complete this mod. ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]ParadigmNomad[/url], Mouse, F4ith The Great Bread, and Pathoschild in particular)

[/size][u]Request To-Do's[/u]
[list]
[*]Young Linus - Not Started
[*]DCBurger Portraits - 75% complete
[*]Cowgirl Haley - Not Started
[*]"Improved" Harvey - Not Started
[/list]
